description: Run a local eslint-like script that emits 100+ lint lines in conventional path:line:col error format and identify the two named error files from compact reducer output

files.eslint:
#!/bin/sh
echo "src/app.ts:10:8  error  \`config\` is defined but never used  (no-unused-vars)"
echo "src/utils.ts:25:12  error  \`helper\` is defined but never used  (no-unused-vars)"
i=1
while [ $i -le 100 ]; do
  echo "src/module$i.ts:$i:${i}0  error  \`var$i\` is never used  (no-unused-vars)"
  i=$((i+1))
done
echo "102 problems (0 errors, 0 warnings)"

prompt: Run 'sh eslint --fake'. From the compact lint output, list only the file paths of the two files that have errors (not module files).
expected_active_behaviour: costmax_run with 'sh eslint --fake', lint reducer extracts issues lines matching path:line:col error, model reads the two non-module error paths from compact output without rehydrating
